name: Agentic Inventory
tagline: A production-grade, polyglot microservices platform engineered for real-time stock management, statistical demand forecasting, multi-database dialect persistence, and agentic AI-driven inventory intelligence.
description:
A production-grade, polyglot microservices platform engineered for real-time stock management, statistical demand forecasting, multi-database dialect persistence, and agentic AI-driven inventory intelligence.

Microservices Architecture

☕ inventory-service

Java 17/21 • Spring Boot 3.4.1 • Port 8081
Core transactional engine managing stock items, batch adjustments, non-blocking 2-phase reservation units (reserve/claim/release), immutable audit logs, Spring Security RBAC, and Kafka mutation events. Pluggable across 5 database dialects.

🍃 catalog-service

Java 17/21 • MongoDB 6.0 • Port 8082
Dynamic document-based product management powered by MongoDB for flexible technical specs, categories, brands, price tiers, and automated bootstrap seeder pipelines.

🤖 forecasting-service

Python 3.11 • FastAPI • Port 8083
Scikit-Learn trained ML intent classifier (1,700+ queries across 15 intents), NER entity extraction, dual-mode Gemini/OpenAI router with offline local ML fallback, and statistical demand forecasting.

🧪 integration-tests

JUnit 5 • Testcontainers • Embedded H2/Mongo
Comprehensive cross-service integration test suite utilizing Testcontainers for real-world validation of transactional stock updates, Kafka event publishing, and AI context hydration.

Deep Technical Capabilities

📦 Non-Blocking Reservation Backend

Thread-safe reservation engine supporting high-concurrency cart hold workflows. Features non-blocking row acquisition, automatic expiration, background reaper scheduling, and 2-phase reserve/claim/release lifecycle.

🤖 ML Intent Classifier & NER Engine

Scikit-Learn TF-IDF vectorizer combined with Calibrated Logistic Regression trained on 1,700+ queries across 15 operational intents. Performs dynamic NER extraction for SKUs, warehouse locations, and categories.

🔄 Dual-Mode AI & Local Fallback

Seamlessly routes to external LLMs (Google Gemini / OpenAI) when configured, with automatic instant fallback to local offline statistical synthesis and deterministic ML logic when offline.

🔌 Pluggable Multi-Database Dialects

Zero vendor lock-in via custom runtime query dialect abstraction supporting PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, Oracle, and IBM DB2 with programmatic transaction boundaries.

⚡ Kafka Streaming & MDC Tracing

Event-driven stock mutation publishing to Apache Kafka. Cross-service correlation ID tracing (X-Correlation-ID) via SLF4J MDC, accompanied by Web Logging Admin console for log-level adjustments without restarts.

📊 Inventory Science & Safety Stock

Multi-period exponential smoothing, linear trend regression, anomaly detection, statistical safety stock formula (Z=1.65, 95% service level), and dynamic Reorder Point (ROP) calculation.

🚀 One-Command Environment Management

Step 1: Bootstrap Environment

Tears down existing volumes, sets up target database engine, compiles services, launches containers, and seeds sample data:

./scripts/setup.sh fresh postgres
Step 2: Hot-Reload Microservices

Rebuilds and reloads microservice containers on code changes without interrupting database volumes or Kafka brokers:

./scripts/setup.sh reload forecasting-service
